text_block_list.text:
I'm waiting for Мэдзиро Райан. She hasn't
shown up
for training yet...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! I didn't mean to skip
training.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I got caught up talking to one of the
younger
students, and...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
As I consider how to respond to Ryan's
apology,
another Umamusume enters the
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... Please don't get mad at
Ryan. It was
all my fault!
text_block_list.name: Younger Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I thought she didn't have any training
today, so I
asked her for advice about
my diet.
text_block_list.name: Younger Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Oh! You didn't have to come. I can
handle it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It appears Ryan is trying to protect this
girl.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Just try to be more careful next time.

text_block_list.text: S-so it's all right? Oh, what a relief.
text_block_list.name: Younger Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
I've learned today that Ryan is very
much beloved
by the younger students.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
